_comment: Immutable hashes of the contributor agreements (#2374).
This file exists so the agreement text can be SEALED before it is active. cla/ACTIVE is what
switches enforcement on, and it must not exist until counsel has approved the text and the
founder instrument is signed — but the text itself can be pinned now, and pinning it now is the
point: it is what stops the draft being edited between approval and activation without anybody
scripts/legal/check-cla-hashes.mjs fails the build when a document changes without its hash and
version being updated together. At activation, `pnpm legal:activate-ip` copies these values into
cla/ACTIVE, so the hash a signature is recorded against is the one that was sealed here rather
than one computed at activation time from whatever the file said by then.
